Scale: the plate is about 450 px wide in the image, which I take as a standard dinner plate of roughly 26 cm. That gives about 0.058 cm per px, or roughly 17 px per cm.

Scrambled eggs: the pile is about 120 px by 130 px, so roughly 7 cm by 7.5 cm. Its height is about 1.5 cm. Its area is about 40 cm² at a fill factor near 0.7, which gives about 28 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 42 cm³. At about 0.9 g/cm³ that is roughly 40 g, so I estimate 45 g.

Pineapple: there are 4 chunks, each about 2 cm across and 1.5 cm thick. Each is about 6 cm³, so about 25 g in total, and I estimate 30 g.

Watermelon: about 10 cubes of roughly 2 cm, so about 8 cm³ each. That is about 80 cm³, or about 80 g. Several pieces are smaller, so I estimate 85 g.

Melon (honeydew): 3 pieces of about 2.5 cm by 2 cm by 1.5 cm, which is about 7 cm³ each. That is about 21 cm³, so I estimate 25 g.
